verdict.rationale: Belvo documents its own background automations. Smart Collections lets you set amounts and balance conditions, then Belvo watches the account in the background and notifies you when funds are available. Recurrent links refresh data weekly and notify you via webhook, and Smart Transfers and Direct Debit automate recurring payments. These are fixed, domain-specific automations rather than a general facility for users to define their own autonomous workflows. Missing for 10: user-defined or general-purpose automation and scheduling, configurable refresh cadence beyond the documented weekly cycle, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these background jobs run reliably.
